mixes.condition: Plain RO — no nutrients. Water only when the usual moisture and plant-readiness check confirms readiness.
mixes.name: Plain RO
mixes.product: Plain reverse-osmosis water; no fertilizer or additives
mixes.rationale: H1, H2 and H3 last received plain RO on September 4. Their replacement medium and healthy active establishment remain unconfirmed, so feeding is not supported yet. Coconut Crystal retains its later occasional lighter-feeding rule; no fertilizer is recommended for it today.

notes: All 30 active pots were reviewed against fresh workbook data read at 9:47 a.m. Eastern on September 15. No weights after the September 14 watering were present at that read.

The 26 separate weigh-ins include 21 missing wet baselines and five current-curve follow-ups. This larger session does not establish a permanent daily weighing schedule. #1 and #2 are flexible samples; the other requests address missing baselines, a nearby window or an uncertain curve.

A1–F3, G1 and G2 were watered after weighing on September 14, at approximately 8:30 p.m. Their previous low weights are valid pre-water context and cannot trigger repeat watering. A1–F3 received MSU at 0.75 g/US gal; G1 and G2 received plain RO.

#3 was watered on September 13 at 7:14 p.m., after its 7:13 p.m. scale reading. Its first post-water weight is also missing. Its recorded Foliage-Pro feeding is part of that completed watering, not a new task.

The five remaining curve samples were last weighed before the September 13 light installation. A fresh point will test for a change in drying pace. #4 is already inside its observation window; #5 and #6 still lack completed dry references.

No supported sustained plateau was found in the current cycles. H1, H2 and H3 qualify through their dry references. G3 also reaches its reference but remains Check only because its leaf cycle controls the watering decision.

For H1, H2 or H3 actually watered today, record a comparable post-drain weight. Those conditional measurements are separate from the 26 other weigh-ins. If a watering occurred after the source read, record the actual event instead of repeating it.

The shared detector matches the live model. No active trend-review warnings, duplicate Observation IDs or formula errors were found. Readiness signals describe measured mass, not proof of a dry root zone; the usual plant-specific check still determines watering.
